name: check_room
description: Check whether a room request is available using whole minutes since midnight in the range 0-1440, the current time, blocked status, and existing bookings. This tool only checks availability; it does not save, create, change, or reserve any booking.

start.description: Requested start time as whole minutes since midnight.

end.description: Requested end time as whole minutes since midnight.

now.description: Current time as whole minutes since midnight.

bookings.description: Existing bookings; an empty list is allowed.
